mostWorthwhile.text: Gathering the studies into subject sections was the most worthwhile passage; it made the final volume feel organized and connected the earlier observations.

leastWorthwhile.text: Pairing the weather and star records felt least engaging because it was the only offered combination and its result was predictable.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the grouping and binding followed the stated goal.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary, although the menu supplied the compatible pairs rather than letting me discover them.

continue.text: I would probably stop here: assembling the encyclopedia was satisfying, but the choices in this chapter were mostly predictable.
